scope: Original pipeline 48-token greedy HF ordinary diagnostic; previously inspected prompts, not blind. No token IDs/EOS metadata retained by this evaluator. Automatic metrics do not establish answer quality.
teacher_forced_agreement_definition: Token-count-weighted agreement across original model generated answer positions; not prompt-token agreement and not only first token.
mean_kl_definition: Original-to-trained KL averaged over original model answer positions within each prompt, then equally over prompts.
